written.text: Read the passage carefully and answer the questions: One of the most widely spread bad habits is the use of tobacco. Tobacco is now chewed or smoked by men, women and even by children, all over the world. It was brought to Europe from America by Sir Walter Raleigh, four centuries ago, and has spread everywhere. I very much doubt whether there is any good in the use of tobacco, even when it is not used in excess. It is extremely difficult to get rid of the habit once it had been formed. Alcohol is taken in almost all cool and cold climates and to a very much less extent in hot ones. Thus, it is taken by people who live in mountains, but not nearly so much by those who live in the plains of India. Alcohol is not necessary in anyway to anybody. Millions of people are doing without it entirely. In India it is not required by people at all, and should be avoided altogether. The regular use of alcohol even in small quantities, tends to cause harm in may ways to various organs of the body. It effects the liver, it weakens the mental power and lessens the general energy of the body. Now answer these questions:(8×1=8)

subparts.a: Does the author feel that tobacco, when not use in excess, is good for health?
subparts.b: Is it easy to give up the habit of smoking?
subparts.c: Is it necessary to consume alcohol?
